title: Classic British Shepherd's Pie
description: A hearty, comforting dish filled with slow-cooked lamb and topped with a crispy, golden-brown crust.
instructions: In a large pan over medium heat, cook the lamb until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour to thicken the mixture, then add the milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the lamb mixture is cooking, boil the chopped potatoes in salted water until they are tender.
Drain the potatoes and mash them with butter, salt, and pepper.
Transfer the lamb mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Top the lamb mixture with the mashed potatoes, spreading them evenly to cover the top.
Sprinkle the breadcrumbs over the top of the potatoes.
Bake the shepherd's pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
